service.description: Live status + per-stage timeline for one reconciliation run. Tenant-gated.

parameter.name: errorDetail
parameter.description: Full failure text. errorMessage is capped at 255 chars to fit a text-medium column, which truncates real Spark/service errors mid-sentence — routinely cutting off the part that names the fix (e.g. the "Did you mean [...]" column suggestion). This is the untruncated text-very-long copy the run row already stored.

parameter.name: cancelRequestedDate
parameter.description: Set once an operator asked to stop the run; it stays RUNNING until the next cancel checkpoint.

parameter.name: resultFileName
parameter.description: Normalized result path once WRITE_OUTPUT lands; lets the live view swap to the saved result on completion.

set.from: stepRows.collect { row -> [stageCode: row.stageCode, stageSequence: row.stageSequence, statusEnumId: row.statusEnumId, startedDate: row.startedDate, completedDate: row.completedDate, recordCount: row.recordCount, errorMessage: row.errorMessage, metricsJson: row.metricsJson] }

service.description: Ask a running reconciliation to stop. Tenant-gated. Cancellation is cooperative: this records the request and the run ends itself AUT_STAT_CANCELLED at its next checkpoint (a stage boundary, or an extract progress tick during a long paged extract), so the run may still report RUNNING for a few seconds after this returns.

else.message: Run '${runIdValue}' could not be cancelled; it may have just finished.

if.message: You will be notified in '${spaceRow.spaceName}' when this run ends.

service.description: Remove the caller's notify-me subscription for one run. Caller-scoped: only the caller's own row for that run is ever deleted. Reports an ERROR when there was nothing to remove instead of reporting success — a retried automation carries subscriptions forward onto the new attempt's run-result row, so a miss on an older id can mean the subscription is alive somewhere else and still due to fire.

else.message: No notification subscription for run '${runIdValue}' belongs to you, so nothing was cancelled. If this run was retried, the subscription moved to the retry — stop it from the latest attempt.

service.description: Return a bounded page of a JSON diff document's differences (plus whole-document facets, effective summary, metadata, and a download descriptor WITHOUT the file body) so darpan-ui can render large reconciliation results without loading the entire file. Audit #21.

parameter.name: fileName
parameter.description: Generated-output result file name or safe relative path returned by list#GeneratedOutputs.

parameter.name: buckets
parameter.description: Comma-separated active diff buckets (file-1,file-2,rule). Empty means all.

parameter.name: ruleFilterKey
parameter.description: Rule selector key ('all', 'base-diff', or a specific rule filter key).

parameter.name: includeFacets
parameter.description: Skip bucket counts + rule options for pure page navigation.

set.from: darpan.facade.reconciliation.ReconciliationOutputSupport.getGeneratedOutputDifferences(ec, fileName, pageIndex, pageSize, buckets, ruleFilterKey, search, includeFacets)
